known_limitations: Honest blind-well floor is persistence ~3.22 (denoised) / 8.68 (raw); the paper's 2.15 needs heavier OPR denoising (disclosed) and the 'AR(3)=2.6' baseline is in-sample/leaky. See docs/REPRODUCTION_NOTES.md sec 8.
SD file decoded as date-aligned aggregation (AW=active-well count, OSH=sum hours, OPR=sum per-well rates); reconstruction fidelity r>=0.976 per feature.
Stage-2 metaheuristic (COA/PSO) is a no-op; hybrid>standalone gap is the epoch budget.
